prompt: Finance wants the new MRR LedgerLoop booked in each month of 2025 (event_date from 1 January to 31 December 2025). Each event's event_type names its movement (new, expansion, contraction, churn or reactivation); a reactivation is an account coming back after it churned, never new MRR. Leave out the opening events: they carry the MRR subscriptions already had when the data starts on 1 January 2024. Count an event in the month of its event_date. Amounts stay in each subscription's own currency, so give one row per currency. Return three columns, in this order: month_start (the first day of the month), currency and new_mrr, the sum of mrr_delta_local of the new events. Return one row for each month and currency with new MRR. Any row order is fine.

output_contract.grain: one row per month of 2025 and currency with new MRR

hints: Next, keep the new events of 2025 and add their MRR up by month and currency.
Only event_type new is new business; a reactivation is an account that came back.
why_this_works: Only new events count as new MRR, and keeping the currency in the grain never adds pounds to euros.
